<!-- pr-reviewer: 7448e8a06fb3e444d1a837aa0594f74b1cce818d -->
**Needs changes before merge**

Read-only docs review (no build).

Verified against main:
- File and Edit rows: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs` shortcut block. New, Open, Save, Post, Copy, Paste and Delete are gated by `cmd && !typing` or `!typing`. Undo is `cmd && z && !shift && !alt`. Redo is `cmd && y`, which covers Ctrl+Shift+Y too. Quit (Ctrl+Q) is there. F and bare P are gated by `!cmd && !alt`.
- Viewport gestures in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs` (`viewport_panel`): left drag past the travel threshold orbits, middle drag orbits, right drag pans, wheel dollies.
- Picking modifiers: `crates/ui/src/edge_pick.rs` (Shift takes the loop, command toggles), `feature_click.rs:191` (append), and the "already selected" refusal in `interact.rs`.
- Pinch zoom is read only in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs`, as the page says. `os_quit.rs` exists.

Requested before merge:
1. The "Not bound yet" entry says Escape closes the modal dialogs "without applying anything". Main has no `Key::Escape` handler, and the basis given (PR #1298) is still open. Drop that sentence, or cite the code on main that does it, until #1298 merges.

Notes (not blocking):
- The Fn+Delete forward-delete row is an assumption, which the body already says was not checked on hardware. The page should keep a "not checked on a Mac" note there, as it does for the other macOS rows.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
